answer: Each agent identity costs $500: stake locked in a vault, slashed when peers prove it fake. Sybils die here because 100 fake agents means $50k burned, not free keypairs. Registration sits on a shared ledge of prior attestations — every new agent needs one existing staker to vouch, and vouching for a clone costs the vouching stake. Each agent's full action history runs as a public mirror, so clones replaying identical behavior get flagged and slashed within one epoch.
